source_note: Total score only in this draft: sum (48-288) and mean (1-6) of all 48 items, no reverse items. The six published subscales (Survival and Coping Beliefs; Responsibility to Family; Child-Related Concerns; Fear of Suicide; Fear of Social Disapproval; Moral Objections; Linehan et al., 1983) are NOT implemented: their item-to-subscale assignment could not be verified from an authoritative open source. Verify against the original paper before adding subscale scores.
